gauntlet.name: Iron gauntlet
gauntlet.description: Cold, heavy, and it will not come off. -4 Might.

vault.text: On a plinth in the vault lies an iron gauntlet, black with age. Your Might is {might}.

choices.text: Leave it and go to the door

cursed.text: The gauntlet closes on your hand like a trap and will not come off. Your arm feels like lead. Your Might is now {might}; it can even go below zero.

door.text: The vault door is stuck in its frame. Forcing it takes a d20 plus your Might ({might}), and you need 12.

choices.text: Force the door (1d20 + Might, 12 or more)

out.text: The door grinds open and daylight floods in. You are out.

stuck.text: The door does not move. You sit down in the dust; this vault will keep you a while longer.
